decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits in the core dairy offer and gives no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration, so it does not prompt problemistic search, though its absence from the website since 2019 adds some uncertainty.
As a former flagship cheese built on the firm's own organic milk supply, it carries strategic commitment, and slack in a growing industry lets the firm keep it despite little recent visibility.
The semi-hard cheese wheel uses existing milk supply and processes at low marginal cost, so without signs of a shortfall it likely meets aspiration and stays.

The soft cheese is the most exposed after the washed-rind soft cheese was dropped, but with no reported shortfall management would carry it a while longer rather than search for other uses of its resources.
